node.statement: To complete the saturated diagonal c2(1,1,2) source-line branch, compile and classify every literal internal source-star assignment across target, sign, ramification, boundary, q-slice, and full quotient gates, or prove a restricted symmetry for that complete system. The aligned-positive unramified registry has 36 semantic cells and is completely PROVED by a disjoint seven-packet census. In the affine near-positive branch, two exact restricted q-slice transports reduce 108 semantic literal cells to 42 orbits: 12 contain the canonical F00/M00 systems and 30 direct representatives enter the exact residual registry. Dual exact certificates close all six F02 representatives. Sequential complete-chart saturation and independent one-step Rabinowitsch ideals also close all six F04 and all six F06 representatives. The affine residual is therefore 12 representatives in the M01 and M03 blocks. The natural reciprocal-pair-swap centralizer extension is exactly refuted. Separate near-positive projective-boundary, aligned-negative, and near-negative literal audits also remain.
